title: Iconography
slide_intent: Introduce the system for drawing small functional signs. The section boundary gives readers a clear transition from expressive illustrations to interface symbols.
strategic_value: Instacart can organize different kinds of image-making within a consistent chapter structure.

practical_value: Use the divider to locate the rules for functional icons before drawing interface controls.
